authors: User-supplied Claude Opus exploration agents; identities recorded by direction in original notes
coverage: Original source notes, search scripts/results and selected composed measurement receipts; no binaries, scratch build products or conversational transcripts. Original scripts retain historical local paths and are not advertised as a portable reproduction. New candidate has its separate complete runner. Archived unproved leads are not dependencies. Full old generated tables are not committed; receipts bind their hashes.
